blocks.text: Homes for Sale in Elgin Chantrell, South Surrey

parts.t: Elgin Chantrell is known for its large lots, acreage properties and its setting on the south bank of the Nicomekl River. Browse all listings below, and contact Jared with any questions about the area.

Elgin Chantrell is the Paragon (MLS) name for the green, river-edge part of South Surrey around Crescent Road, 137 Street, 24 Avenue and 32 Avenue. It brings together two local names, Elgin and Chantrell Creek. Most homes here are single-family houses, some on regular urban lots and some on

lots under Surrey's RA Acreage Residential Zone. If you are looking at a larger lot, the things to check are the RA zone rules, Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) status, and whether the home is on a well and septic system.
I think of Elgin Chantrell as the quiet side of South Surrey: the Nicomekl River on the north, Crescent Road winding through old Elgin, and big trees on many streets.

The City of Surrey does not publish one boundary map for "Elgin Chantrell". City and school district pages use the two local names, Elgin and Chantrell Creek. When you see Elgin Chantrell on a listing, it means this pocket between the Nicomekl River and 24 Avenue, west of King George Boulevard.

blocks.text: Roads and getting around Crescent Rd, 24 Ave, 32 Ave & Hwy 99

parts.t: The main roads are Crescent Road, King George Boulevard, 24 Avenue, 32 Avenue, 137 Street and 144 Street. Highway 99 is reached north of 32 Avenue. TransLink route 352 runs along the Crescent Road corridor, and route 351 runs between White Rock Centre and Bridgeport Station through the South Surrey Park & Ride.

blocks.text: Schools Chantrell Creek & Elgin Park Secondary

parts.t: Two public schools sit inside the area: Chantrell Creek Elementary at 2575 137 Street and Elgin Park Secondary at 13484 24 Avenue. Being near a school is not the same as being in its catchment. Surrey Schools sets catchment by home address through its School Locator, so check each address before you rely on it. On the Surrey Schools boundary map, most of Elgin Chantrell is in the Chantrell Creek Elementary catchment, with Crescent Park Elementary covering the western end along Crescent Road. The secondary catchment is Elgin Park Secondary.

blocks.text: Parks, trails and recreation Elgin Heritage Park & Sunnyside Acres

parts.t: Elgin Heritage Park, at 13723 Crescent Road, sits on the Nicomekl River at the Historic Stewart Farm site. On the east side, Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park at 2598 144 Street has a network of forest trails, including the Wally Ross universal-access trail and the Douglas-fir and Moss trails.
For groceries and errands, most people head to Peninsula Village at 15355 24 Avenue or Semiahmoo Shopping Centre at 1711 152 Street.

blocks.text: Acreage lots: what the RA zone allows 4,050 m² minimum · Coach house rules

parts.t: This is the part buyers ask me about most. Under Part 12 of Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000, the RA Acreage Residential Zone is meant for lots of about one acre or more. The minimum lot size for a new subdivision is 4,050 m², with a minimum width of 50 m and depth of 60 m. An RA lot may hold up to two dwelling units. Accessory uses can include a secondary suite, a garden suite or a coach house. A coach house must be at least 35 m² and is usually capped at 75 m², not counting a garage or carport. The cap can rise to 120 m² where the main house has not used its full permitted floor area. Agriculture and horticulture uses are allowed only on lots of 2 hectares or larger. A lot that is not connected to community water or sewer is limited to two dwelling units. My
page covers what to check on vacant land.

blocks.text: Wells, septic and the ALR GWELLS, Fraser Health & ALC map

parts.t: Some Elgin Chantrell properties are on private wells and septic systems. The Province keeps well records in its GWELLS system, though older wells may not appear there. Fraser Health says a home not on a community sewer needs an onsite system that meets the Sewerage System Regulation, and only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair or inspect it: a Professional Engineer or a Registered Onsite Wastewater Practitioner. Check ALR status parcel by parcel in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder, searched by PID or address. East of Highway 99,
has more acreage and farm land.
Is Elgin Chantrell an official City of Surrey neighbourhood?
It is a Paragon (MLS) name that combines two local names, Elgin and Chantrell Creek. The City and school district use those two names, but there is no single City boundary for "Elgin Chantrell".
What is the smallest acreage lot that can be created in the RA zone?
Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000, Part 12, sets the RA minimum at 4,050 m², with a minimum width of 50 m and depth of 60 m.
Can an acreage home here have a coach house?
Yes. The RA zone lists a coach house as an accessory use. It must be at least 35 m² and is usually capped at 75 m², or 120 m² in some cases. Confirm the details for the specific lot with the City.
How do I check whether a property is in the ALR?
Use the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder and search by PID or address.
Who can work on a septic system?
Fraser Health says only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect a sewerage system: a Professional Engineer or a Registered Onsite Wastewater Practitioner.
Which schools are in the area?

Chantrell Creek Elementary and Elgin Park Secondary are both inside the area. Catchment depends on the exact address, so check the SD36 School Locator. The boundary map puts most of the area in Chantrell Creek Elementary and Elgin Park Secondary, with Crescent Park Elementary at the western end.
